# Values from the table (in millions)
fy1947 = 1459.5  # FY 1947 appropriation
fy1950 = 2106.4  # FY 1950 appropriation (Korean War started June 1950)

n = 3  # years from FY 1947 to FY 1950

print(f"FY 1947: ${fy1947} million")
print(f"FY 1950: ${fy1950} million")
print(f"Years: {n}")
print(f"Ratio: {fy1950/fy1947:.6f}")
print(f"CAGR: {cagr:.6f}%")
print(f"Rounded to nearest thousandth: {round(cagr, 3)}%")
